projects.title: Alpha Wheel Bearings
projects.description: Campaign imagery developed to support the launch of CeramicSpeed ALPHA Bearings. Produced in Copenhagen with rider Virginia Palermo, the project was structured across two distinct environments. The first documented the bearing installation process within a controlled studio setting, while the second presented the completed system in use through an outdoor riding sequence.

projects.title: The Lemma Project
projects.description:
A collaborative project between Polymer Workshop, Officine Mattio, and CeramicSpeed, developed around the creation of the first complete bicycle featuring the full Polymer Workshop component system, including wheels, handlebar, and seatpost.

The project also involved a reinterpretation of the Officine Mattio Lemma RT frameset through a custom paint treatment and revised logo placement, establishing a more unified visual language across the complete build. The project concluded with the production of a dedicated image and video campaign in Cuneo, the home of Officine Mattio.

The completed bicycle was released as a limited edition of 20 units worldwide.

projects.title: Machine Portrait
projects.description:
An ongoing portrait series presenting custom-built road and gravel bicycles assembled with Polymer Workshop components. Each build is photographed within a distinct visual setting, selected to create a considered contrast while complementing the overall character and specification of the bicycle.

The series is intended to demonstrate the breadth of possible configurations and compatibility between Polymer Workshop components and frames from established bicycle manufacturers, while serving as a source of reference and inspiration for individual builds.
